sloka: अथान्तरिक्षे देवानामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्।अभिजज्ञे च सन्नादो गन्धर्वाप्सरसामपि ।। ६.९१.७८ ।।
transliteration: athāntarikṣe devānāmṛṣīṇāṁ ca mahātmanām।abhijajñe ca sannādo gandharvāpsarasāmapi ।। 6.91.78 ।।

translations.english: Then shouts of victory aroused from the heavens from the created beings of heaven, Rsis also, Gandharvas and Apsaras.
